item.title: Emirates, Etihad Cancel More US–UAE Flights Amid Winter Storm
item.description: Emirates and Etihad Airways have cancelled additional flights to and from the United States on Monday as a powerful winter storm sweeps across the Northeast. The blizzard has prompted travel bans, flight suspensions and widespread shutdowns across major cities, including New York, New Jersey and Boston. item.title: Saudi Arabia Warns Of Dust Storms, Strong Winds Across Several Regions Until Saturday
item.description: The National Center of Meteorology warned of increased dust storms, strong winds and rising wave heights beginning Tuesday, Feb. 24, and continuing through Saturday, Feb. 28. The center said the regions most affected by the unstable weather conditions include Tabuk, Madinah and Makkah, including coastal areas, as well as Al-Jawf, the Northern Borders and Hail. item.title: Saudi Arabia Posts SR276.61 Billion Budget Deficit In 2025
item.description: Saudi Arabia recorded total revenues of SR1.11 trillion in 2025, while expenditures reached approximately SR1.389 trillion, resulting in a budget deficit of SR276.61 billion, the Ministry of Finance announced. According to the ministry’s report, oil revenues totaled SR606.54 billion, accounting for 54.55% of total revenues. item.title: Saudi Arabia Reverses Restriction, Allows Foreign Companies In Government Projects
item.description: Saudi Arabia has reversed its previous restriction and now permits government entities to contract with international companies and institutions that do not have a regional headquarters in the Kingdom. item.title: Warehouse Fire In Abu Dhabi Brought Under Control, No Injuries Reported
item.description: Abu Dhabi police and civil defence teams brought a warehouse fire under control on Monday morning, after it broke out in the Al Muzoon area of the capital, authorities said. The incident did not result in any injuries. Emergency crews responded immediately to contain the blaze and prevent it from spreading to nearby facilities. item.title: Bahrain: 81 Illegal Workers Deported In One Week
item.description: The Labour Market Regulatory Authority (LMRA) carried out 1,514 inspection campaigns and visits between February 15 and 21, 2026, resulting in the arrest of 24 irregular workers. During the same period, 81 violators were deported from Bahrain. The authority said that 1,476 inspection visits were conducted across commercial establishments in all governorates, in addition to 38 joint inspection campaigns. item.title: Bahrain Expands Ban On Single-Use Plastic Bags
item.description: Industry and Commerce Minister Abdullah bin Adel Fakhro has announced a new decision banning the manufacture, import and sale of single-use plastic bags that are less than 57 microns thick. The new rule, issued under Decision No. (7) of 2026, is part of Bahrain’s efforts to reduce plastic waste and move toward more environmentally friendly practices. item.description: His Highness Shaikh Khalid bin Hamad Al Khalifa, Deputy Chairman of the Supreme Council for Youth and Sports, Chairman of the General Authority for Sports, and President of the Bahrain Olympic Committee, received the Bahraini swimming team that completed His Highness’ 44.5-kilometer swimming challenge.
